transfer_boundary.source_domain: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 simulated turbofan degradation
transfer_boundary.warehouse_use: C-MAPSS endpoint predictions are used only as controlled surrogate degradation inputs

sampling.base_design: sample one endpoint prediction from each empirical quintile and permute the five values across A1-A5
sampling.alternative_design: sample five endpoint predictions without replacement
sampling.negative_noise_policy: clip perturbed surrogate inputs to zero

formulas.consequence: criticality_weight * criticality / 5 + throughput_weight * throughput / 5 + severity_weight * severity / 5

assets.configuration_criterion: Important inbound path with short buffering and a limited temporary workaround
assets.criticality_justification: Major process dependency, but limited short-term continuity remains
assets.severity_justification: Moderate disruption and recovery exposure without a severe safety or continuity assumption

assets.configuration_criterion: Main sortation route with no full-capacity bypass
assets.criticality_justification: System-critical route with no effective substitute
assets.severity_justification: Serious service and business-continuity exposure, but not the maximum catastrophic category

assets.configuration_criterion: Limited vertical redundancy and difficult recovery
assets.criticality_justification: Major process dependency with restricted redundancy
assets.severity_justification: Difficult recovery and serious service or damage exposure

assets.configuration_criterion: One unit within a multi-vehicle fleet; workload can be redistributed
assets.criticality_justification: Strong fleet redundancy limits the interruption
assets.severity_justification: Minor local service and recovery effect

assets.configuration_criterion: One of two packing paths; partial capacity remains available
assets.criticality_justification: An important process is affected, but a workable alternative remains
assets.severity_justification: Partial capacity remains and the assumed non-throughput effect is minor

criticality.1: local auxiliary role with an immediately available substitute
criticality.2: minor local interruption with strong redundancy
criticality.3: one important process is affected, but a workable alternative exists
criticality.4: major process dependency with limited redundancy or difficult recovery
criticality.5: system-critical single point of failure with no effective substitute

severity.1: negligible non-throughput effect and straightforward recovery
severity.2: minor damage, service or cost effect
severity.4: serious safety, damage, service, recovery or cost exposure
severity.5: severe safety, regulatory, damage or business-continuity consequence

score_criteria.adjacent_score_test: move each author-assigned score one anchor down or up where feasible, bounded to 1-5

supported: stated predictive performance on C-MAPSS FD001
predeclared mathematical behaviour of the priority index
measured internal stability or sensitivity under controlled changes
ranking changes produced by the declared warehouse scenario variables
